about_the_game:
Combine equipment and unlock powerful skills!
In this fantasy auto-battler where Orcs, Elves, and Humans clash, collect as many trophies as you can.
You only have 10 rounds — victory depends on your strategy!

GladiArena is a fantasy auto-battler where equipment and strategy dominate the battlefield.
Choose your tribe — Orc, Elf, or Human — and build your own combat unit by purchasing, enhancing, and unlocking skills through equipment.

Battles are automated, but strategy is everything.
Before each round, use the shop to acquire or upgrade gear and prepare for battle.
You’ll face off against AI opponents based on real player data, aiming to collect as many trophies as possible over the course of 10 rounds.

Some players will break your perfect setup — and others will fall helplessly before your carefully planned strategy.
Only the smartest, most adaptable warriors will survive in this arena.

This is a single-player game, where AI battles are based on actual player snapshots.
Your unit can become someone else's opponent, and vice versa — enabling asynchronous PvP combat without the need for real-time matching.

This game is currently in Early Access, and we are actively working on the following features:

  • Equipment Fusion System – Combine duplicate gear to craft higher-grade equipment.

  • 3-Unit Team Battles – Broaden your strategy with multi-unit combat.

  • More Gear, More Skills – Expanding the arsenal of weapons and armor.

  • Game Balance Improvements – Ongoing adjustments for fair and exciting gameplay.

  • Ranked Mode – Compete for the top spot in a seasonal ranking system.

This game uses AI-generated images for its background and UI.
